name: Low-UI Paper
concept: The UI recedes until only text remains — white paper and black paper, after iA Writer, e-ink readers, Swiss typography and Calm Technology. One typeface (iA Writer Quattro), one accent, no panel tints, no shadows. The stage axis is a gradient of visibility: level-1 is calm but every control is visible, level-3 'quiet' removes all lines and moves chrome into the periphery (hover/focus reveal), level-5 'invisible' is a blank sheet where chrome sits at ~3% contrast — but text stays ≥4.5:1 and the focus ring is always drawn.

sources.title: iA Writer fonts (Quattro, Mono) — OFL 1.1, iA asks for credit
iA Writer focus mode (product page, reference screenshots)
Dieter Rams — ten principles for good design
Butterick's Practical Typography (line length, body size)
WCAG 2.2 (1.4.3 contrast, 1.4.11 non-text contrast, 2.4.7/2.4.11 focus, 2.5.8 target size)

limits: Element Call and widget iframes only know light/dark; their content stays Element-styled, we only strip their frame.
Hashed CSS-module classes (event tile states, highlight, new room list, badges) need [class*="_local_"] selectors and a version shim.
Notification badges force cpd-theme-light; tokens must be set on [class*="cpd-theme-"] too, else pills reappear coloured.
Default avatar colours from Avatar.ts (favicon/notifications) are hard-coded and cannot be made grayscale.
iA focus dimming via :nth-last-child is unreliable in Element's scroll-anchored timeline (date separators, read markers, hidden events count as children) — enhancer marker preferred.
Off-canvas left panel (level-5) must not move React nodes: done with transform/grid on .mx_LeftPanel_outerWrapper, so the resize separator needs to be hidden too.
Invisible stage deliberately fails WCAG 1.4.11 (non-text contrast) for resting component boundaries and weakens discoverability; text contrast and focus visibility are kept.
iA's licence note asks not to clone iA products: the variants are named 'Paper', not 'iA Writer', and the fonts are credited in the README and settings gallery.

variants.motion: 150ms opacity fades only; no transforms; reduced-motion disables them
signature: warm #FBFBF8 sheet with no panel tinting — sidebar, header and timeline are the same paper
iA Writer Quattro everywhere, 17px/1.6 body in a 68ch column
iA-blue block caret (#1AA3FF) in the composer
unread = bold + • glyph, mentions = '@' + underline; no coloured pills
grayscale avatars and ink-only usernames

regions.shell: one flat sheet: canvas = panels = header, no panel tints, no shadows; 1px hairline only between left column and timeline
regions.spaces: narrow text-ish rail, space avatars grayscale at 85% opacity, selected = 2px ink bar left; no backgrounds
regions.roomlist: plain text list 15px, no avatars/icons in rows, selected = weight 600 + 2px left rule, unread = bold + • glyph, sections as small caps
regions.header: room name 22px/600 flush-left, topic one line in muted, icon buttons muted until hover; hairline bottom
regions.timeline: book column max 68ch, 17px/1.6, IRC/modern layout, sender in small caps above group, continuation = paragraphs; whitespace instead of rules
regions.names-avatars: names in ink small caps (no rainbow: all decorative text tokens → ink/muted), avatars grayscale round 24px
regions.composer: borderless field on a single top hairline, iA-blue caret #1AA3FF, placeholder muted, send button visible but muted
regions.rightpanel: same sheet colour, hairline left border, cards as text sections with small caps headings
regions.buttons: primary = ink text with 1px ink border, no fill (accent fill only for the one destructive/confirm action); secondary = text link style
regions.inputs: 1px hairline bottom border only; on focus 2px accent bottom + focus ring
regions.dialogs: white sheet, 1px ink border at 20%, 2px radius, no shadow, backdrop = canvas at 85% opacity
regions.menus: canvas bg, 1px hairline border, no shadow, hover = wash #F2F1EC / #181818; tooltips inverted ink-on-paper
regions.settings: tabbed view as text list, active tab = weight 600 + 2px rule, toggles rendered as text-coloured outline switches
regions.auth: centered 68ch column on bare paper, no background art, wordmark replaced by room-name typography
regions.scrollbars: thin 6px, thumb = border colour, no track
regions.focus: 2px solid accent outline, offset 3px (≥3:1 against paper)
regions.badges: no pills: unread counts as tabular-nums muted digits; mentions = '@' + underline; critical only for mentions/highlights
regions.code: iA Writer Mono, background = hover wash, hljs reduced to 3 inks (keyword weight 700, string muted, comment italic muted)
regions.iframes: Element Call / widgets stay Element light; only the .mx_AppTile frame is restyled (no border, ink title in small caps)
regions.icons: Compound icons kept, recoloured to muted (icon tokens → text-secondary), 20px
